definitions: A familiar and often transparent deception or method of trickery.
A well-known and frequently used deceptive tactic.
examples: He tried to use the oldest trick in the book to get out of paying the bill.
Don't fall for that; it's the oldest trick in the book.
She recognized the oldest trick in the book when he pretended to be lost.
lemma: the oldest trick in the book
